thread:
morgan: Heads-up — console wants to map the new adaptive-quota telemetry into route priority buckets in the SDKs. Might be a breaking change if we don't coordinate.

alex: Do we have a final header name? Platform currently emits `x-redwood-quota-policy` but casing/format differs across languages.

sasha: We pushed a platform patch that emits `X-Redwood-Quota-Policy: adaptive=v2;sample=0.05` (single header string). SDKs need to parse it into structured fields.

ben: TS SDK currently lowercases headers and treats unknown keys as opaque strings — that will break our parser :grimacing:

sasha: Console ingestion also expects `route_priority` as part of telemetry events to map to quota buckets.

morgan: Options: 1) make SDKs accept both cased variants 2) normalize in the proxy/edge 3) switch to JSON body for policy (bigger change).

alex: I prefer SDK-side fallback to avoid infra churn. Proposal: add public client API like `client.setQuotaPolicy({ adaptive: 'v2', sample: 0.05 })` and SDKs emit a canonical header.

eva: Is that too SDK-specific? Python already has `client.quota_policy = {}` in some internal branches. We should keep parity across Py/TS/Go.

ben: I can implement a compat shim in TS that reads both `x-redwood-quota-policy` and `X-Redwood-Quota-Policy` and parses into a structured object, but it'll need tests + a feature flag.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: queued rollout to dev for ts-sdk v1.12.0-canary

morgan: Also console wants sampling rate surfaced in telemetry as `quota.sampler.version` (so we can filter evals by sample version).

sasha: If SDKs send both the header and telemetry `quota_policy` object, platform can dedupe on request_id. That should keep ingestion sane.

alex: Agreement candidate: SDKs emit canonical lowercased header `x-redwood-quota-policy` and also include a structured telemetry event `quota_policy` with identical fields. Add an opt-in `SDK-Compat` header when the shim is active.

ben: Plan: add parsing + emit `SDK-Compat: quota-header-shim` when env `RW_SHIM_QUOTA_HEADER=true`. I'll open a PR with tests for header parsing, roundtrip, and mismatch logs.

eva: Python will mirror TS behavior (`RW_SHIM_QUOTA_HEADER` env toggle). Go team — add parse in `RoundTripper`.

morgan: Action items: ben -> TS PR + unit/integration tests; eva -> Py mirror; sasha -> update platform docs and sample header; alex -> update console mapping to prefer telemetry field if present. Can we get canary by EOD? :rocket:

alex: SG. Console ingestion will prefer `quota_policy` in telemetry (fall back to header) to preserve compatibility.

sasha: Header config snippet for platform docs: ```
X-Redwood-Quota-Policy: adaptive=v2;sample=0.05;route_priority=fast
``` send as a single header string (semicolons).

ben: Got it. I'll also log a warn-level message when telemetry `quota_policy` differs from parsed header for 48h to catch drift.

morgan: Thanks all — ping here when PRs are open and I'll coordinate the console canary test.
